_readme: 這一份是 /stories/ 的劇本：三個學生，每個八關。**現在全部是範例**，demo 是 true，每一句引言的 meta 都寫著（範例）。
換成真的劇本：Mentorship 從真實學員抓三個案例、Curriculum 從故事與信裡挑每一關的引言，照下面的欄位填進來，然後把 demo 改成 false。
程式一行都不用動。畫面上看得到的每一個字都從這裡來（還有 people.json 與 src/strings.js）。
紅線：未成年學員不放姓名、不放學校名、不放錄取結果。引言去識別化。每一句都要有同意。
欄位：
personas[]        三個學生。id 就是網址的 #a #b #c。
tag_zh/en       卡片上那一句（像標題）。
grade_zh/en     年級。
start_zh/en     起點：他是誰、卡在哪。兩三句。
gate_zh/en      他最後走的那扇門（台灣的大學、社區大學、獎學金）。
outcome_zh/en   結尾那一屏他自己說的一句話。
letter_zh/en    放榜之後翻開的那封信（探索營寫給一年後自己的信，節錄）。letter_meta_zh/en 是來源，不放名字。
scenes[]        八關，順序就是畫面順序。id 固定八個：hall hear camp mentor list family essay result。
kind          choice（一般）、wall（便利貼牆）、map（故事地圖）、letter（放榜後的信）。只是畫面提示，選項的結構都一樣。
title_zh/en   這一關的名字。
situation_zh/en  情境，兩三句，用「你」。
choices[2]    兩個選擇，沒有對錯，兩條都走到下一關。
label_zh/en 按鈕上的字。
quote_zh/en 選完出現的一句真實學員的話。quote_meta_zh/en 寫年份與場合，不寫名字。
bt_zh/en    這時候 BT 做了什麼，一行。team 是哪個 team（Curriculum Mentorship Internship CR Sponsorship Marketing）。
person      這時候出現在你旁邊的人，對到 people.json 的 code。沒有就留空字串。
notes[]           便利貼牆上的便利貼：text_zh/en、session_zh/en（哪一場）。探索營現場收，寫的人同意才放。

personas.start_zh: 成績全校前段，家裡沒有人出過國。以為出國念書是私立學校的事，直到一位學姐回學校演講。
personas.start_en: Top of her class. Nobody in the family has studied abroad. She thought going abroad was a private school thing, until an alumna came back to speak.
personas.outcome_zh: 我把每一扇門都看過了。這一扇是我自己選的。
personas.outcome_en: I saw every gate. This one was mine to choose.
personas.letter_zh: 一年後的我：不管你人在哪裡，記得你是看過所有選項才決定的。這件事沒有人替你做。
personas.letter_en: To me a year from now: wherever you are, remember you chose after seeing every option. Nobody did that for you.
personas.letter_meta_zh: 探索營 · 給一年後的自己（範例）

scenes.situation_zh: 高三開學。大廳裡只有一個登機門亮著：學測。所有人都往那裡走。
scenes.situation_en: Senior year begins. Only one gate in the hall is lit: the entrance exam. Everyone is walking toward it.

choices.quote_zh: 我沒想過有別條路。班上沒有人想過。
choices.quote_en: I never thought there was another road. Nobody in my class did.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高三（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

choices.quote_zh: 我只是想知道其他門後面有什麼。沒有要走。
choices.quote_en: I just wanted to know what was behind the other gates. Not to go.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高三（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

scenes.situation_zh: 週會。一位從你們學校畢業、現在在國外念書的學姐回來講她怎麼申請的。演講結束，她說可以留下來問問題。
scenes.situation_en: Assembly. An alumna from your school, now studying abroad, explains how she applied. When she finishes, she says she will stay for questions.

choices.quote_zh: 我問她：你們學校有補習班嗎？她笑說沒有，她也是公立的。
choices.quote_en: I asked her if her school had cram classes for this. She laughed and said no, she went to a public school too.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024 校園講座（範例）
choices.bt_zh: CR team 安排學長姐回公立高中演講。這一場就是他們排的。
choices.bt_en: The CR team sends alumni back to public high schools to speak. This talk was one of theirs.

choices.quote_zh: 我沒留下來，但我把她的 IG 記下來了。那天晚上我看了三個小時。
choices.quote_en: I did not stay, but I wrote down her Instagram. I read for three hours that night.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024 校園講座（範例）
choices.bt_zh: CR team 安排學長姐回公立高中演講，講完把 BT 的 IG 留在黑板上。
choices.bt_en: The CR team sends alumni back to public high schools to speak, and leaves BT's Instagram on the board.

scenes.situation_zh: 寒假兩天的探索營。第一天結束前，每個人拿到一張便利貼，貼到牆上。
scenes.situation_en: Two days of winter bootcamp. Before day one ends, everyone gets a sticky note to put on the wall.

choices.label_en: Write what you are afraid of
choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：怕爸媽覺得我看不起台灣。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: afraid my parents will think I look down on Taiwan.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 冬（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 辦探索營，兩天免費。你看學長姐真的送出去的文件，改自己的。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team runs the bootcamp, two days, free. You read the essays alumni actually submitted and edit your own.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：想知道外面長什麼樣，然後自己決定。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: I want to see what is out there, then decide myself.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 冬（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 辦探索營，兩天免費。你看學長姐真的送出去的文件，改自己的。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team runs the bootcamp, two days, free. You read the essays alumni actually submitted and edit your own.

scenes.situation_zh: 探索營之後可以申請配對一位學長姐，一學期一次。地圖上亮著的是現在在線上的人。挑一個比你早走幾步的。
scenes.situation_en: After bootcamp you can be paired with an alumnus for a semester. The lights on the map are the people who are around. Pick someone a few steps ahead of you.

choices.quote_zh: 她第一句話是：你不用現在決定要不要出國。先把文件寫出來再說。
choices.quote_en: Her first words: you do not have to decide about leaving yet. Write the documents first.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 一學期配對一次。不幫你寫 essay，陪你把卡住的地方講清楚。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team pairs once a semester. They do not write your essay. They help you say what you are stuck on.

choices.quote_zh: 他申請過國外，最後留在台灣。他說：那不是失敗，那是我看完之後選的。
choices.quote_en: He had applied abroad and stayed in Taiwan. He said: that was not a failure, that was what I chose after looking.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 一學期配對一次。配的是走過同一條路的人，不一定在國外。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team pairs once a semester, with someone who walked the same road, not always someone abroad.

scenes.situation_zh: Mentor 給了你十二所學校的名單。你只有時間送六所。
scenes.situation_en: Your mentor gives you a list of twelve schools. You only have time to apply to six.

choices.quote_zh: 我那時候全部挑安全的。後來 mentor 問我：那你為什麼要出國？
choices.quote_en: I picked all safe schools. Then my mentor asked: so why do you want to go abroad?
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 陪你把十二所縮成六所。縮的方法比結果重要。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor helps you cut twelve to six. How you cut matters more than what is left.

choices.quote_zh: 衝的那三所我一所都沒上。但我寫那三份文件的時候，才知道自己想要什麼。
choices.quote_en: I got into none of the three reach schools. But writing those three essays was when I found out what I wanted.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 陪你把十二所縮成六所。縮的方法比結果重要。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor helps you cut twelve to six. How you cut matters more than what is left.

scenes.situation_zh: 文件寫到一半。爸媽只知道你在準備學測。
scenes.situation_en: Halfway through the essays. Your parents only know you are preparing for the entrance exam.

choices.quote_zh: 我媽第一個反應是：那學測呢？我說學測我也考。她就沒再問了。
choices.quote_en: My mother's first reaction: what about the exam? I said I was taking it too. She did not ask again.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營有一場給家長的說明。很多家長的問題跟你爸媽一樣。
choices.bt_en: The bootcamp has a session for parents. Most parents ask the same questions yours do.

choices.quote_zh: 我拖到放榜。回頭看，早一點講他們反而比較放心。
choices.quote_en: I waited until results came out. Looking back, telling them earlier would have put them at ease.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營有一場給家長的說明。很多家長的問題跟你爸媽一樣。
choices.bt_en: The bootcamp has a session for parents. Most parents ask the same questions yours do.

scenes.situation_zh: 最後一篇 essay。題目是「一件改變你的事」。你有兩個版本。
scenes.situation_en: The last essay. The prompt is "something that changed you". You have two drafts.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫阿嬤教我種菜。mentor 說：這篇才像你。
choices.quote_en: I wrote about my grandmother teaching me to grow vegetables. My mentor said: this one sounds like you.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 送出前一週，Curriculum 開一場 essay 工作坊，學長姐一對一看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: The week before the deadline, Curriculum runs an essay workshop. Alumni read the final draft one on one.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫社團。mentor 說可以，但問我：你阿嬤那篇為什麼不敢交？
choices.quote_en: I wrote about the club. My mentor said fine, then asked: why are you afraid to submit the one about your grandmother?
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 送出前一週，Curriculum 開一場 essay 工作坊，學長姐一對一看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: The week before the deadline, Curriculum runs an essay workshop. Alumni read the final draft one on one.

scenes.situation_zh: 三月。國外的信來了，學測的成績也出來了。兩邊都有門開著。
scenes.situation_en: March. The letters from abroad arrive, and the exam results are out. Doors are open on both sides.

choices.quote_zh: 上了一所。我看著那封信很久，然後發現我其實想留下來。
choices.quote_en: I got into one. I looked at that letter for a long time, then realised I actually wanted to stay.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次。不是慶祝，是陪你把兩邊的門看清楚。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call. Not to celebrate. To look at both doors with you.

choices.quote_zh: 學測夠上台大。我跟 mentor 講的時候，他說：你知道這是你選的嗎？我說我知道。
choices.quote_en: The exam score was enough for the top school here. When I told my mentor, he said: you know this is your choice, right? I said I know.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次。不是慶祝，是陪你把兩邊的門看清楚。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call. Not to celebrate. To look at both doors with you.

personas.tag_en: The cheap door is a real door
personas.start_zh: 台北的公立高中。知道有這條路，但家裡付得起台灣的學費，付不起國外四年。他以為這扇門是給有錢人的。
personas.start_en: A public high school in Taipei. He knows the road exists, but his family can pay for Taiwan, not four years abroad. He assumes the door is for rich families.
personas.outcome_zh: 沒有人跟我說過，便宜的那扇門也是真的門。
personas.outcome_en: Nobody told me the cheap door was a real door.
personas.letter_zh: 一年後的我：如果你在社區大學，不要跟任何人道歉。你算過了，那是你算出來的路。
personas.letter_en: To me a year from now: if you are at a community college, apologise to nobody. You did the maths. That road is yours.
personas.letter_meta_zh: 探索營 · 給一年後的自己（範例）

scenes.situation_zh: 高二。大廳裡只有一個登機門亮著：學測。你知道還有別的門，但門口寫著一個你付不起的數字。
scenes.situation_en: Junior year. Only one gate in the hall is lit: the entrance exam. You know there are other gates, but each has a number on it you cannot pay.

choices.quote_zh: 我算過一次，四年要一千萬。算完就關掉了。
choices.quote_en: I did the maths once, four years was ten million. I closed the tab.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高二（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

choices.quote_zh: 我把學費抄在筆記本最後一頁。沒有打算做什麼，只是不想忘記。
choices.quote_en: I wrote the tuition on the last page of my notebook. No plan. I just did not want to forget it.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高二（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

scenes.situation_zh: IG 上滑到一場免費的線上說明會：公立高中生怎麼申請國外。你有一個小時的空檔。
scenes.situation_en: You scroll past a free online session on Instagram: how public high school students apply abroad. You have one free hour.

choices.quote_zh: 講者說她家也付不起。我第一次聽到有人講錢。
choices.quote_en: The speaker said her family could not afford it either. It was the first time I heard anyone talk about money.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024 線上說明會（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Marketing team 把每一場免費活動放上 IG。你看到的那一則就是他們排的。
choices.bt_en: The Marketing team posts every free event on Instagram. That post was theirs.

choices.quote_zh: 我存了兩個月才看。看完的那天就報名探索營了。
choices.quote_en: I saved it for two months before watching. The day I watched, I signed up for the bootcamp.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024 線上說明會（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Marketing team 把每一場說明會的錄影留在 IG 上，什麼時候看都還在。
choices.bt_en: The Marketing team keeps every session's recording on Instagram, so it is there whenever you are ready.

scenes.situation_zh: 暑假的探索營。有一堂課叫「錢從哪裡來」。下課前每個人寫一張便利貼。
scenes.situation_en: Summer bootcamp. One class is called "where the money comes from". Before it ends, everyone writes a sticky note.

choices.label_en: Write what you are afraid of
choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：怕我爸知道我在算這個。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: afraid my dad finds out I am doing this maths.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 夏（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 那一堂課講三條路：獎學金、社區大學轉學、台灣讀完再出去。沒有一條叫「有錢人的路」。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team's money class covers three roads: scholarships, community college transfer, and finishing in Taiwan first. None of them is "the rich road".

choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：一條我付得起的路。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: a road I can afford.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 夏（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 那一堂課講三條路：獎學金、社區大學轉學、台灣讀完再出去。沒有一條叫「有錢人的路」。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team's money class covers three roads: scholarships, community college transfer, and finishing in Taiwan first. None of them is "the rich road".

scenes.situation_zh: 配對表上可以勾你想要的 mentor 背景。地圖上亮著的是現在有空的人。
scenes.situation_en: The pairing form lets you tick what kind of mentor you want. The lights on the map are the people who have time.

choices.label_zh: 從社區大學轉學的學長
choices.label_en: Someone who transferred from a community college
choices.quote_zh: 他說他第一年住在親戚家打工。我問他後悔嗎，他說只後悔沒早一點知道。
choices.quote_en: He said he lived with relatives and worked his first year. I asked if he regretted it. He said he only regretted not knowing sooner.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 照你勾的背景配。要找走過便宜那條路的人，就配走過的人。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team matches on what you tick. Ask for someone who took the cheap road and you get someone who did.

choices.quote_zh: 她說獎學金不是運氣，是三十份申請裡的一份。我開始列清單。
choices.quote_en: She said the scholarship was not luck, it was one of thirty applications. I started a list.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 照你勾的背景配。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team matches on what you tick.

scenes.situation_zh: Mentor 幫你列了一張表：左邊是四年制大學加獎學金，右邊是社區大學兩年再轉。兩邊的總金額差三倍。
scenes.situation_en: Your mentor draws a table: four-year universities with aid on the left, two years at a community college then transfer on the right. The totals differ by three times.

choices.quote_zh: 我兩邊都送了。四年制的獎學金沒拿到，社區大學變成我真的走的路。
choices.quote_en: I applied to both. The four-year aid did not come through. The community college became the road I actually walked.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 不替你選，但會要你兩邊都算到最後一塊錢。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor does not choose for you, but makes you work both sides down to the last dollar.

choices.quote_zh: 決定那天我鬆了一口氣。原來選一條付得起的路，不是放棄。
choices.quote_en: The day I decided, I felt relief. Choosing a road I could afford was not giving up.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 不替你選，但會要你兩邊都算到最後一塊錢。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor does not choose for you, but makes you work both sides down to the last dollar.

scenes.situation_zh: 你要跟爸爸講「社區大學」這四個字。他沒聽過。
scenes.situation_en: You have to say the words "community college" to your father. He has never heard them.

choices.quote_zh: 他看了五分鐘，問了一句：轉得過去嗎？我說學長轉過去了。
choices.quote_en: He looked at it for five minutes and asked one thing: can you really transfer? I said my mentor did.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營的家長場有一位走過這條路的學長的爸爸來講。
choices.bt_en: At the bootcamp parents' session, the father of an alumnus who took this road speaks.

choices.quote_zh: 我先講出國，他以為要一千萬，臉都白了。後來看到表才鬆下來。
choices.quote_en: I said abroad first. He thought ten million and went pale. He only relaxed when he saw the table.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營的家長場有一位走過這條路的學長的爸爸來講。
choices.bt_en: At the bootcamp parents' session, the father of an alumnus who took this road speaks.

scenes.situation_zh: 社區大學的申請很短，但有一欄「為什麼是我們」。你有兩個版本。
scenes.situation_en: The community college application is short, but has one field: "why us". You have two drafts.

choices.quote_zh: 我老實寫我付得起。mentor 說：對，然後再加一句你要拿它做什麼。
choices.quote_en: I wrote honestly that I could afford it. My mentor said: yes, now add one line on what you will do with it.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Internship team 的學長姐在送出前一週看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: Alumni from the Internship team read the final draft the week before the deadline.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫了兩年後要轉去哪裡。寫完才發現，我已經有計畫了。
choices.quote_en: I wrote where I would transfer in two years. Only after writing it did I realise I had a plan.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Internship team 的學長姐在送出前一週看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: Alumni from the Internship team read the final draft the week before the deadline.

scenes.situation_zh: 社區大學的錄取信來了，附一張學費單。數字跟你筆記本最後一頁差不多。
scenes.situation_en: The community college acceptance arrives with a tuition bill. The number is about what you wrote on the last page of your notebook.

choices.quote_zh: 他看了數字，說：這個可以。那是他第一次說可以。
choices.quote_en: He looked at the number and said: this one works. It was the first time he said yes.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次，把兩年後轉學的時程排出來。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call and maps out the transfer two years ahead.

choices.label_en: Send it to your mentor first
choices.quote_zh: 他回我一句：歡迎。然後傳了他當年的學費單給我，數字一樣。
choices.quote_en: He replied with one word: welcome. Then sent me his own tuition bill from back then. Same number.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次，把兩年後轉學的時程排出來。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call and maps out the transfer two years ahead.

personas.start_zh: 家裡收入不高。她從來沒想過申請，因為「那要花錢」。一個朋友硬拉她去探索營。
personas.start_en: Family income is low. She never considered applying because "it costs money". A friend drags her to a bootcamp.
personas.gate_en: A US college, with need-based aid
personas.outcome_zh: 我差一點沒申請，因為我以為要花錢。
personas.outcome_en: I almost did not apply, because I thought it cost money.
personas.letter_zh: 一年後的我：不管結果怎樣，至少你送出去了。以前的你連想都不敢想。
personas.letter_en: To me a year from now: whatever happened, at least you submitted. The old you did not dare to even think about it.
personas.letter_meta_zh: 探索營 · 給一年後的自己（範例）

scenes.situation_zh: 高三。大廳裡只有一個登機門亮著：學測。你連其他門在哪都沒找過，因為你知道你付不起。
scenes.situation_en: Senior year. Only one gate in the hall is lit: the entrance exam. You never looked for the other gates, because you know you cannot pay.

choices.quote_zh: 出國這兩個字在我家是別人家的事。
choices.quote_en: In my house, "abroad" was something that happened to other families.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高三（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

choices.quote_zh: 我多看了一眼，然後罵自己浪費時間。
choices.quote_en: I took one more look, then told myself off for wasting time.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 高三（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 這時候 BT 還沒出現。這就是 BT 要解決的那一刻。
choices.bt_en: BT is not here yet. This is the exact moment BT exists for.

scenes.situation_zh: 朋友報了探索營，說是免費的，拉你一起。你那個週末本來要打工。
scenes.situation_en: A friend signed up for the bootcamp, says it is free, and drags you along. You were supposed to work that weekend.

choices.quote_zh: 我請了兩天假。第一堂課講者就說：我家也沒錢，我是全額補助進去的。
choices.quote_en: I took two days off. In the first class the speaker said: my family had no money either, I went on full aid.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 探索營（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營對學員是 0 元。Sponsorship team 讓它維持 0 元。
choices.bt_en: The bootcamp costs students nothing. The Sponsorship team keeps it that way.

choices.quote_zh: 我只去了第一天，然後打電話跟店長說第二天也要請假。
choices.quote_en: I went for day one, then called my manager to ask for day two off as well.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 探索營（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營對學員是 0 元。Sponsorship team 讓它維持 0 元。
choices.bt_en: The bootcamp costs students nothing. The Sponsorship team keeps it that way.

scenes.situation_zh: 第二天下午講獎學金與補助。黑板上寫著幾間學校「看家庭收入給補助，不看國籍」。下課前每個人寫一張便利貼。
scenes.situation_en: Day two afternoon is about aid. On the board: a few schools that give aid by family income, regardless of passport. Before class ends, everyone writes a sticky note.

choices.label_en: Write what you are afraid of
choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：怕申請了，被人說我在作夢。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: afraid that if I apply, people will say I am dreaming.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 夏（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 那一堂課，是全場唯一一堂每個人都抄筆記的課。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team's aid class is the one class where everyone takes notes.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫的是：試一次。就一次。
choices.quote_en: I wrote: try once. Just once.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 探索營便利貼 · 2025 夏（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Curriculum team 那一堂課，是全場唯一一堂每個人都抄筆記的課。
choices.bt_en: The Curriculum team's aid class is the one class where everyone takes notes.

scenes.situation_zh: 配對表上有一格「希望 mentor 懂的事」。你寫了「補助」。地圖上亮起來的是懂的人。
scenes.situation_en: The pairing form has a field: "what I hope my mentor understands". You write "aid". The lights on the map are the people who do.

choices.quote_zh: 她第一次視訊就把她當年的補助申請表打開給我看，一格一格講。
choices.quote_en: On our first call she opened her own aid application from back then and walked me through it field by field.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 配對時看你寫的那一格。寫補助，就配懂補助的人。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team reads that field when pairing. Write aid, get someone who knows aid.

choices.label_zh: 在台灣念書、申請過的學長
choices.label_en: Someone in Taiwan who applied before
choices.quote_zh: 他沒拿到補助，留在台灣。他說：至少你申請了會知道答案，不申請永遠不知道。
choices.quote_en: He did not get aid and stayed in Taiwan. He said: at least if you apply you will know. If you do not, you never will.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 配對（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentorship team 配對時看你寫的那一格。
choices.bt_en: The Mentorship team reads that field when pairing.

scenes.situation_zh: 會給國際學生全額補助的學校很少，而且很難進。Mentor 說：名單要短，但不能只有這些。
scenes.situation_en: Very few schools give full aid to international students, and they are hard to get into. Your mentor says: keep the list short, but not only those.

choices.quote_zh: 我只送了四所。mentor 沒反對，但要我把台灣的學測也考好。
choices.quote_en: I applied to four. My mentor did not object, but made me take the Taiwan exam seriously too.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 不會跟你說「一定上」。會跟你說「兩邊都準備」。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor never says "you will get in". They say "prepare both sides".

choices.quote_zh: 部分補助那兩所，我算了還是付不起。但 mentor 說送了才知道他們給多少。
choices.quote_en: The two partial-aid schools were still too expensive on paper. But my mentor said you only find out how much they give by applying.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 不會跟你說「一定上」。會跟你說「兩邊都準備」。
choices.bt_en: Your mentor never says "you will get in". They say "prepare both sides".

scenes.situation_zh: 補助申請要填家裡的收入。你一定要跟媽媽講。
scenes.situation_en: The aid application needs your family's income. You have to tell your mother.

choices.quote_zh: 我媽說：我們家的收入填上去，人家會給錢？我說會。她不信，但還是把薪資單拿給我。
choices.quote_en: My mother said: we put our income in and they give money? I said yes. She did not believe me, but handed me her pay slip.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 探索營的家長場特別講補助，因為最不相信的通常是家長。
choices.bt_en: The bootcamp's parents' session covers aid on purpose, because the parents are usually the ones who do not believe it.

choices.quote_zh: mentor 跟我媽視訊了二十分鐘。掛掉之後我媽說：那個女生也是這樣進去的喔？
choices.quote_en: My mentor spoke to my mother on video for twenty minutes. Afterwards my mother said: so that girl got in this way too?
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: Mentor 願意的話，可以跟家長講一次。這不在規定裡，但常常發生。
choices.bt_en: If a mentor is willing, they will talk to the parents once. Not a rule, but it happens often.

scenes.situation_zh: Essay 題目是「你克服過什麼」。你不想寫家裡沒錢。
scenes.situation_en: The essay prompt is "something you overcame". You do not want to write about money.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫早餐店。寫到一半發現，我其實是在寫為什麼我值得這個補助。
choices.quote_en: I wrote about the breakfast shop. Halfway through I realised I was writing why I deserved the aid.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 送出前一週 Curriculum 開 essay 工作坊，學長姐一對一看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: The week before the deadline Curriculum runs an essay workshop. Alumni read the final draft one on one.

choices.quote_zh: 我寫社團。學姐看完說很好，然後問：早餐店那件事為什麼沒寫？
choices.quote_en: I wrote about a club. The alumna said it was good, then asked: why is the breakfast shop not in here?
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2024（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 送出前一週 Curriculum 開 essay 工作坊，學長姐一對一看最後一版。
choices.bt_en: The week before the deadline Curriculum runs an essay workshop. Alumni read the final draft one on one.

scenes.situation_zh: 三月底。信箱裡有一封信，標題有「financial aid」。
scenes.situation_en: End of March. There is an email in the inbox with "financial aid" in the subject line.

choices.quote_zh: 我在教室後面開的。數字是全額。我沒哭，我去找我媽。
choices.quote_en: I opened it at the back of the classroom. It was full aid. I did not cry. I went to find my mother.
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次。拿到補助的人，接下來要辦的事還有一整頁。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call. For someone on aid, the to-do list that follows is a full page.

choices.quote_zh: 我媽看不懂英文，我念給她聽。念到數字那一行，她問我：是他們付？
choices.quote_en: My mother cannot read English, so I read it to her. At the line with the number she asked: they pay?
choices.quote_meta_zh: 真實學員 · 2025 放榜（範例）
choices.bt_zh: 放榜那週，mentor 會約一次。拿到補助的人，接下來要辦的事還有一整頁。
choices.bt_en: The week results come out, your mentor books one more call. For someone on aid, the to-do list that follows is a full page.

notes.text_en: So public school kids can too
Come back and tell the juniors
Afraid my parents will not understand
I want to be a mentor too
Still have to do the exam
So there is someone to ask
